title: Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

pages.lesson:
LESSON: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Fruit of the Holy Spirit. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives
   In simple words: practise until you can describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Fruit of the Holy Spirit using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Fruit of the Holy Spirit in the examples.
2. Explain Fruit of the Holy Spirit to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Fruit of the Holy Spirit.
4. Show that you can: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Fruit of the Holy Spirit using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Fruit of the Holy Spirit important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In pairs, read Galatians 5:22-23,
2. List the fruit of the Holy Spirit
3. Write the fruit of the Holy Spirit on flash cards and display it in class,
4. In groups, list good things they should do to others as Christians,
5. Discuss how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their daily lives,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
